sections.titre: SUPERMARCHÉ DU COLONEL en quelques mots
paragraphes: À Nevers, les recherches du type « commerce d'alimentation près de chez moi » se concluent le plus souvent par un appel ou une visite directe.

Le commerce alimentaire de proximité redevient un réflexe, mais son information circule mal : jours de marché, produits de saison, vente directe. Cette fiche rassemble ce que le consommateur cherche avant de se déplacer.
D'après le relevé du 30 août 2026, l'établissement est ouvert sept jours sur sept. Le détail jour par jour figure plus bas.
L'établissement est situé au 2 Rue du Colonel Jeanpierre, 58000 Nevers.
Coordonnées géographiques : 46.99264, 3.13326. Le lien d'itinéraire ci-dessous ouvre directement la navigation.
Le contact se fait par téléphone au 03 86 38 37 66. C'est le seul moyen de communication déclaré sur la fiche Google de l'entreprise, avec la visite sur place.
Si vous dirigez cette entreprise, vous pouvez demander la correction ou le retrait de cette page à tout moment, sans justification.

liste.texte: Sorry to have bothered you! A knack for business isn't for everyone, but to lack it to this extent warrants a visit... Go in knowing what you're getting into; you'll leave either laughing or... horrified 😉

The staff was extremely unpleasant. I asked a question about dropping off a Mondial Relay parcel, and the man walked right past me and went into the back room without answering. Thinking he hadn't heard me, I waited patiently for him to come out and politely asked him the same question again. Still no answer; I was talking to a brick wall. Unacceptable. It wasn't like this before; has there been a change of ownership?

I went to pick up a package because this shop acts as a parcel collection point. After 20 minutes, I left empty-handed, even though the package had been delivered to the shop. The shopkeeper spoke little to no French. I'm not sure he could even read the names on the packages…
I don't recommend it. I certainly won't be going back to this shop.
Great, full of products you can't find anywhere else, and very polite and pleasant people! A lovely atmosphere
I really like it; there's a bit of everything at very reasonable prices. Open until late afternoon with friendly service, this local shop has quickly become indispensable.
